description: This PHP file contains functions for logging ad requests, impressions, clicks, conversions, variable values, and managing ad/campaign/zone limitations and blocking cookies within the Revive Adserver delivery engine.

methods.name: MAX_Delivery_log_logAdRequest
methods.description: Logs an ad request if request logging is enabled, invoking hooks for plugins.

methods.name: MAX_Delivery_log_logAdImpression
methods.description: Logs an ad impression if enabled and not blocked, invoking hooks for plugins.

methods.name: MAX_Delivery_log_logAdClick
methods.description: Logs an ad click if enabled, invoking hooks for plugins.

methods.name: MAX_Delivery_log_logConversion
methods.description: Logs a conversion if tracker impression logging is enabled, returning info or false.

methods.name: MAX_Delivery_log_logVariableValues
methods.description: Logs variable values for a tracker, sanitizing and passing to hooks.

methods.name: _viewersHostOkayToLog
methods.description: Checks if viewer's IP/host and user-agent are allowed to be logged based on configuration.

methods.name: MAX_Delivery_log_getArrGetVariable
methods.description: Returns GET variable as an array, exploded on delimiter.

methods.name: MAX_Delivery_log_ensureIntegerSet
methods.description: Ensures array index is set and is an integer.

methods.name: MAX_Delivery_log_setAdLimitations
methods.description: Sets ad capping cookies for a given index.

methods.name: MAX_Delivery_log_setCampaignLimitations
methods.description: Sets campaign capping cookies for a given index.

methods.name: MAX_Delivery_log_setZoneLimitations
methods.description: Sets zone capping cookies for a given index.

methods.name: MAX_Delivery_log_setLastAction
methods.description: Sets or updates last action cookie for conversions.

methods.name: MAX_Delivery_log_setClickBlocked
methods.description: Sets click blocked cookie for an ad.

methods.name: MAX_Delivery_log_isClickBlocked
methods.description: Checks if click logging for an ad is currently blocked.

methods.name: _setLimitations
methods.description: Private function to set or update delivery blocking/capping cookies for Ad, Campaign, or Zone.
